name: Goi cuon tom
summary: Gỏi cuốn tôm is boiled shrimp, greens, and rice noodles rolled in rice paper, cool and not greasy. Dip it in mắm nêm or peanut sauce.
origin: Vung Tau, on Cô Giang and Xô Viết Nghệ Tĩnh.
taste: The roll is cool and not greasy, and the dip is mắm nêm or peanut sauce.
howToEat: Pick up a roll, dip it, and bite.
where: Cô Giang and Xô Viết Nghệ Tĩnh.
seoTitle: Goi cuon tom — shrimp rolls in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Shrimp gỏi cuốn in Vung Tau: boiled shrimp, greens, and rice noodles in rice paper, dipped in mắm nêm or peanut sauce.
